async def act(page):
    # Try to find and click the 'Previous Post' link using Accessibility Tree-centric selectors
    try:
        # Use get_by_role with link role and name 'Previous Post' (case-insensitive substring match)
        previous_post_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Previous Post")
        await previous_post_link.click()
        # Wait for navigation to complete
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        # After clicking, get the new page title to return as result
        new_title = await page.title()
        return new_title
    except Exception as e:
        # If not found by role, try get_by_text as a fallback
        try:
            previous_post_link = page.get_by_text("Previous Post")
            await previous_post_link.click()
            await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
            new_title = await page.title()
            return new_title
        except Exception as e2:
            # If still not found, try to get all links and filter by text
            try:
                all_links = page.get_by_role("link")
                # Filter for links with text containing 'Previous' (case-insensitive)
                previous_post_link = all_links.filter(has_text="Previous").or_(all_links.filter(has_text="previous")).first
                await previous_post_link.click()
                await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
                new_title = await page.title()
                return new_title
            except Exception as e3:
                # If all attempts fail, return an error message
                return "Could not find 'Previous Post' link on the page after multiple attempts."
